name: ART (Agent Reinforcement Trainer)
summary: Open-source Python framework for training multi-step agents with GRPO, with an OpenAI-compatible client and a separate GPU training server.
description: Install pip install openpipe-art (PyPI 0.5.24; Python 3.12+). ART collects agent trajectories and rewards, trains with GRPO, and reloads updated LoRA checkpoints for subsequent rollouts. RULER can generate rewards automatically. The client can run on a laptop while the server runs on your own GPU machine. Apache-2.0 code; serverless W&B Training is a separate service and compute is not included.

agent_access.notes: Public source repository; local library. Model services and compute have separate requirements and costs.
